newsitem.title: USA: Arco sees Calif. diesel unit back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Arco sees Calif. diesel unit back Friday.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co said Wednesday the hydrocracker at its 265,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Carson, Calif., will restart Friday after a leak earlier this week caused the unit to make faulty diesel fuel.
"We expect to have it up Friday," a refinery spokesman said.
The shutdown forced refinery traders to buy 60,000 barrels of diesel fuel earlier this week to cover production lost from the 4,000 bpd unit.
The spokesman said the heavy fuel normally sent to the hydrocracker is running through a midbarrel unit, which can also make diesel.
On Tuesday, diesel fuel prices in Los Angeles rose about one to two cents after traders heard about the problem.
